description: If you want to vote in-person, you may return your mail ballot and vote in-person at a voter service and polling center. Even if you do not return your mail ballot you may still vote in person. The deadline to vote in-person is 7:00 PM on Election Day. Go to https://www.coloradosos.gov/pubs/ele
